versions.name: Tanah Keeta Scout Reservation
versions.address: 8501 SE Boy Scout Rd, Jupiter, FL 33469

features.note: A wheelchair-accessible campsite with accessible showers and restrooms; cart transport between sessions on request.
Limited power is available in most campsites.
A climbing tower, with night climbing offered as an evening activity.
The Angler Adventure covers shore, pier, inlet, lake, and deep-sea fishing toward the Complete Angler award.
Adventure Programmes run on and off camp property for experienced Scouts.
Adventure Programmes are aimed at Scouts who have already camped several years.
A remodelled swimming pool, also used for scuba training sessions.
The TK Provo Troop lets Scouts attend without their unit, camping in staff-supervised patrols.
Three levels of scuba certification, framed by the camp as its ultimate underwater high adventure.
A guided snorkel tour run off camp property.
Riverfront on the Loxahatchee plus spring-fed lakes, giving access to four types of waterway.

versions.summary: Gulf Stream Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp in Jupiter, Florida.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
